No allocation/corruption cause or physical/JIT origin inferred. The finite origin question is answered; no automatic repeat or collector expansion.

Your explicit release let Wolf take generation26 before analysis. I am forwarding the evidence to Flexe now for bounded offline interpretation and minimal failing-mode admission/rollback proposal, preserving original firmware and source. No repair or further6502 target run yet. The guest-only exact palette21 candidate remains independently useful; preserve its frozen references and accepted original profiles. I will return a concrete generic/runtime or emulator contract once the source-owner interpretation is in.
